nodes.question: What are the two forms of MSI mentioned in the literature?
nodes.answer: The two forms of MSI mentioned are standard-setting MSIs, such as the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) and the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), and MSIs that correspond to the continuous improvement model.
